name: Editorial magazine
idea: The page reads like a printed feature story: confident serif display type, a strong grid, room to breathe.
composition: Asymmetric 12-column grid; a headline that spans most of the width over a narrow standfirst; pull quotes breaking the grid; sections numbered like chapters; generous margins; text set in measured columns, not cards.
type: High-contrast serif display (Playfair Display, Bodoni Moda, DM Serif Display, Gloock) with a quiet grotesk or book serif for text (Newsreader, Spectral, Hanken Grotesk). Italics for emphasis, small caps or tracked capitals for kickers, drop caps welcome.
colour: Paper-white or bone background, near-black ink, one editorial accent (oxblood, cobalt, saffron) used sparingly for kickers and rules.
imagery: Large photographs at magazine proportions (4:5, 3:2) with captions and photo credits; one full-bleed image breaking the column.
details: Hairline rules between sections, bylines, issue numbers, folio-style page markers, no rounded corners, no shadows.

name: Swiss international
idea: Objective, rational, grid-first: information arranged with mathematical clarity and flush-left type.
composition: Visible modular grid; flush-left ragged-right text; strong horizontal bands; content aligned hard to column edges; big numbers and labels as structure; lots of deliberate empty space.
type: One neo-grotesk family in several weights (Schibsted Grotesk, Hanken Grotesk, Familjen Grotesk, Work Sans), very large headline sizes against small text, tight leading on display, generous on body.
colour: White and black with a single primary signal colour (signal red, Swiss blue or yellow) used as a field, not a decoration.
imagery: Photography cropped tightly into grid cells, or replaced entirely by geometric blocks of colour and type.
details: Thin rules, index numbers, arrows (→), no ornament, no rounded corners, no gradients.

name: Raw brutalist
idea: Deliberately unpolished, honest, web-native: default-looking elements used with conviction.
composition: Stacked full-width blocks; visible borders around everything; text that runs edge to edge; deliberately awkward alignments; long lists and tables shown plainly; little hierarchy beyond size.
type: System-like or monospaced faces (Space Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Courier Prime, Archivo) at large sizes; underlined links; uppercase labels.
colour: Stark: white or grey background, black text, one loud web colour (pure blue links, acid green, hot pink) or none at all.
imagery: Raw rectangles, unprocessed photos, or none; ASCII-like separators.
details: Thick black borders, default-looking buttons, visible table lines, no shadows, no radius, no smooth transitions.

name: Neo-brutal pop
idea: Bold, friendly and loud: chunky outlines and hard offset shadows on saturated colour.
composition: Card-heavy layouts where every card has a thick black border and a hard offset shadow; tilted stickers and badges; elements that overlap slightly; big CTA buttons.
type: Chunky geometric or grotesk display (Archivo Black, Rubik, Space Grotesk, Lexend) with a plain sans for body.
colour: Saturated flat colours — lemon, lilac, mint, tomato, sky — each section on a different one, all outlined in black.
imagery: Placeholders as flat colour fields with bold outlines; simple inline SVG shapes (stars, squiggles, arrows).
details: 3–4px black borders, solid offset shadows (e.g. shadow-[6px_6px_0_0] in ink), small radius or none, rotated labels.

name: Quiet luxury
idea: Expensive by restraint: very little on the page, all of it perfect.
composition: Centred or strongly symmetric; vast whitespace; one idea per screen; small amounts of text; slow vertical rhythm; images given entire sections.
type: Elegant light serif or refined display (Cormorant Garamond, Italiana, Marcellus, Cinzel) in widely tracked capitals and large light italics; a fine sans for small text (Jost, Montserrat light).
colour: Ivory, champagne, stone, deep espresso or black; a hint of metallic (muted gold, bronze) only in thin lines.
imagery: Large, calm, single photographs with lots of negative space; product shown as an object on a plain field.
details: Hairlines, tiny tracked labels, no icons, buttons as text with an underline or thin outline, no radius.

name: Retro print / risograph
idea: Feels printed: limited ink colours, overprint, grain and mid-century confidence.
composition: Poster-like hero; blocks offset as if misregistered; stacked bands of flat colour; playful but grid-based.
type: Rounded or chunky retro display (Shrikhand, Righteous, Bungee, Abril Fatface, Rubik Mono One) with a sturdy text face (Work Sans, Karla, Courier Prime for labels).
colour: Two or three ink colours that overprint (fluorescent pink, teal, federal blue, sunflower) on cream paper.
imagery: Duotone placeholders, halftone-dot patterns via CSS radial gradients, simple SVG shapes in ink colours.
details: Mix-blend-multiply overlaps, slightly offset duplicate shapes, stamps and badges, grain implied by dotted patterns.

name: Cut-paper collage
idea: Hand-assembled and joyful: pieces of paper, photos and type layered at angles.
composition: Overlapping elements at slight rotations; scattered composition in the hero; content blocks pinned like notes; free placement over a loose grid.
type: A bold expressive display (Syne, Unbounded, Gochi Hand, Permanent Marker) mixed with a clean sans; words broken onto separate coloured strips.
colour: Kraft, cream and white paper tones with two bright accents and black.
imagery: Placeholders shaped like torn or taped photos (rotated, with tape strips made from translucent rectangles); SVG scribbles.
details: Tape, pins, stickers, hand-drawn arrows and underlines, small rotations (rotate-[-3deg]), drop shadows like paper on a table.

name: Dark technical
idea: Precise, engineered, after-hours: product as instrument.
composition: Dark canvas; a product screenshot or diagram as the hero; feature grids drawn with 1px borders; code-like snippets; metrics and specs as structure.
type: Precise grotesk (Geist-like: Manrope, Sora, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans) with a mono (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono) for labels and numbers.
colour: Near-black and graphite surfaces, cool greys, one luminous accent (electric lime, cyan, violet) used for glows and active states.
imagery: UI mockups built from divs; grid backgrounds; subtle radial glows; thin line diagrams in SVG.
details: 1px borders at low opacity, small radius, keyboard-key chips, status dots, monospaced numbers.

name: Typographic poster
idea: Type is the image: enormous words carry the whole design.
composition: Headlines at 15–25vw-equivalent sizes (use fixed large rem sizes), words breaking across lines, text cropped by the edges, very few other elements, sections each built around one huge word.
type: Condensed or extended display (Anton, Big Shoulders Display, Bebas Neue, Unbounded, Archivo at its widest width) at extreme sizes, tight leading, mixed with a small sans.
colour: Two colours at most, high contrast, often one inverted section.
imagery: Little or none; images can sit inside or behind the type.
details: Negative letter-spacing on display, outlined text (text-transparent with stroke via [-webkit-text-stroke]), marquee-like repeated words.

name: Warm handmade
idea: Made by people: craft, warmth and imperfection.
composition: Relaxed, slightly irregular layout; rounded organic shapes as section backgrounds; text blocks like recipe cards or labels; personal story placed prominently.
type: A characterful soft serif or hand-feel display (Young Serif, Caprasimo, Gloock, Kalam, Caveat for notes) with a friendly readable text face (Nunito Sans, Karla, Lora).
colour: Earthy, cooked colours — terracotta, butter, sage, cocoa, flour-white.
imagery: Placeholders with irregular blob shapes (border-radius in percentages), hand-drawn SVG doodles and underlines.
details: Wavy section dividers (SVG), stamp-like badges, handwritten annotations, generous rounded corners.

name: Y2K futurism
idea: Glossy optimism from the year 2000: chrome, bubbles and techno-pop.
composition: Centred hero with floating objects; pill-shaped panels; starbursts; layered translucent windows.
type: Wide techno display (Michroma, Orbitron, Syne, Unbounded) with a rounded sans for body (Varela Round, Nunito).
colour: Iridescent: silver, ice blue, lilac, bubblegum pink, lime, on pale or deep-blue backgrounds.
imagery: Chrome-like gradients (multi-stop linear gradients), glossy blobs, star and sparkle SVGs.
details: Pill buttons with inner highlights, heavy blur glows, outlined stars, gradient borders.

name: Nordic calm
idea: Soft, functional, quietly warm: daylight and good materials.
composition: Simple balanced layouts; two-column image-and-text pairs; plenty of air; content in a gentle stepped rhythm.
type: Clean humanist sans (Figtree, Plus Jakarta Sans, Outfit) with an optional soft serif for headings (Newsreader).
colour: Oat, fog, pale sage, dusty blue, warm white; text in soft charcoal rather than black.
imagery: Natural-light photos of materials and spaces; placeholders in soft tints.
details: Medium radius, very soft or no shadows, thin dividers, unhurried spacing.

name: Bauhaus geometric
idea: Primary shapes and primary colours as the building blocks of the page.
composition: Sections built from circles, squares and half-circles as structural elements; strong diagonals; balanced asymmetry.
type: Geometric sans (Josefin Sans, Jost, Poppins, Lexend) in bold weights, often all caps, sometimes set vertically.
colour: Red, yellow, blue, black and off-white — flat, no gradients.
imagery: Compositions of SVG/CSS shapes instead of photos; photos, when used, cropped into circles or semicircles.
details: Thick bars, circles as bullets, rotated text, no shadows.

name: Art deco
idea: Glamour and geometry of the 1920s: symmetry, fans, gold lines.
composition: Strict symmetry; framed panels with stepped corners; centred headings between ornamental lines; tall vertical proportions.
type: Deco display (Poiret One, Limelight, Italiana, Marcellus, Cinzel) with an elegant sans (Josefin Sans) for text.
colour: Black, emerald or navy with gold or brass lines; cream text.
imagery: Arched or stepped photo frames; fan and sunburst SVG ornaments.
details: Double borders, chevrons, sunbursts, corner ornaments, tracked capitals.

name: Newspaper broadsheet
idea: News-dense and authoritative: columns, datelines and a masthead.
composition: Masthead across the top; multi-column text; headline hierarchy of several sizes; lead story with image; sidebars and boxed briefs.
type: Old-style or news serif (Old Standard TT, Libre Caslon Text, EB Garamond, Newsreader); a blackletter or condensed serif for the masthead (UnifrakturMaguntia, Playfair Display SC).
colour: Newsprint off-white and black; at most one spot colour.
imagery: Photos with captions in columns; small engravings implied with line SVGs.
details: Column rules, datelines, 'continued' markers, boxed briefs, no rounded corners.

name: Punk zine
idea: Photocopied, DIY, rebellious: cut-and-paste urgency.
composition: Chaotic but readable; ransom-note headlines; rotated blocks; text over images; hand-numbered sections.
type: Typewriter and marker faces (Special Elite, Courier Prime, Permanent Marker, Rock Salt) mixed with heavy condensed sans (Anton).
colour: Black, white and photocopy grey with one fluorescent highlight (safety orange, neon yellow).
imagery: High-contrast black-and-white placeholders, halftone patterns, scribbled SVG marks.
details: Highlighter strokes behind words, tape, staples, rotated stamps, crossed-out words.

name: Botanical wellness
idea: Calm, natural, restorative: plants, light and slow breathing.
composition: Flowing layouts with organic curved section edges; centred quiet headlines; generous padding; content in soft cards.
type: Gentle serif (Cormorant, Lora, Newsreader) with a light rounded sans (Quicksand, Nunito).
colour: Sage, eucalyptus, clay, sand, blush; low contrast backgrounds with readable ink.
imagery: Arched photo frames (rounded-t-full); leaf and stem line illustrations in SVG.
details: Arches, soft blobs, thin botanical line art, large radius.

name: Glass and aurora
idea: Luminous and dimensional: frosted panels floating over soft colour light.
composition: Hero over a blurred multi-colour gradient field; content on frosted translucent cards; layered depth.
type: Modern geometric sans (Sora, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans) with medium weights.
colour: Deep indigo or white base with aurora gradients (violet, teal, coral) behind translucent white panels.
imagery: Gradient orbs (blurred circles), device mockups built from divs.
details: backdrop-blur panels, 1px light borders at low opacity, soft large shadows, generous radius.

name: Japanese minimal
idea: Ma — meaningful emptiness: restraint, balance and quiet detail.
composition: Off-centre balance; large empty areas; small precise text blocks; vertical text accents; slow, sparse sections.
type: Refined serif or gothic (Shippori Mincho, Noto Serif JP, Zen Kaku Gothic New) with tiny tracked labels.
colour: Rice paper, sumi ink black, indigo, a single vermilion seal-like accent.
imagery: Small framed images with wide margins; brush-like SVG strokes.
details: Vertical writing-mode labels, seal-stamp squares, hairlines, no radius.

name: Memphis 80s
idea: Irreverent postmodern pattern party: squiggles, confetti and clashing colour.
composition: Busy decorated backgrounds behind clear content panels; shapes scattered around headings; playful zig-zag section breaks.
type: Bold quirky display (Bungee, Righteous, Lilita One) with a geometric sans (Poppins, Lexend).
colour: Clashing pastels and brights — mint, coral, lemon, lavender, black accents.
imagery: Pattern fills (dots, stripes, triangles via CSS gradients), squiggle SVGs.
details: Zig-zag borders, confetti shapes, black outlines, slight rotations.

name: Industrial utility
idea: Spec-sheet honesty: labels, codes, measurements — the product as equipment.
composition: Dense information grids; tables of specs; part numbers and codes as headings; modular panels like equipment labels.
type: Condensed industrial sans (Barlow Condensed, Saira Condensed, Oswald, Chakra Petch) with a mono for data.
colour: Steel grey, concrete, black, with hazard yellow or safety orange.
imagery: Technical line drawings in SVG; product placeholders on grid paper.
details: Barcodes implied with stripes, warning stripes, serial numbers, corner brackets, measurement ticks.

name: Textile maximalism
idea: Rich pattern and colour drawn from woven and printed fabrics: celebratory, bold, vibrant.
composition: Patterned bands framing calm content areas; bold geometric borders; full-colour sections alternating with pattern strips.
type: Strong display (Unbounded, Syne, Rubik, Lexend Zetta) with a sturdy sans.
colour: Rich saturated combinations — indigo, marigold, emerald, crimson, cocoa — confidently mixed.
imagery: Repeating geometric patterns built with CSS gradients or inline SVG; photos framed by pattern borders.
details: Pattern strips as dividers, diamond and zig-zag motifs, bold frames.

name: Vintage label
idea: Old shop labels and packaging: ornate frames, careful lettering, heritage.
composition: Centred label-like blocks; framed panels; product cards styled as labels; established-in dates.
type: Vintage serif and slab (Abril Fatface, Rye, Playfair Display, Old Standard TT) with small capitals and italic script accents (Pinyon Script, sparingly).
colour: Aged paper, deep green, burgundy, faded gold, black.
imagery: Oval and circular frames; engraved-style SVG ornaments.
details: Double-rule frames, ribbons, 'Est.' dates, fleurons, numbered batches.

name: Cinematic
idea: Like a film title sequence: dark, full-bleed, atmospheric, dramatic pacing.
composition: Full-bleed image sections with text over gradients; one statement per screen; letterbox proportions (21:9); credits-like lists.
type: Elegant condensed or wide display (Bebas Neue, Oswald light, Cormorant for drama) with a light sans for text.
colour: Deep blacks and shadows with one warm or cold grade (amber, teal).
imagery: Large atmospheric placeholders with gradient vignettes and captions describing the shot.
details: Letterbox bars, scene numbers, film-credit typography, subtle grain implied by noise patterns.

name: Scrapbook notebook
idea: A personal notebook: lined paper, sticky notes, doodles and handwriting.
composition: Sections as notebook pages; sticky notes and polaroids pinned around; checklists; margins with notes.
type: Handwriting accents (Caveat, Patrick Hand, Kalam) with a readable serif or sans for body (Lora, Nunito Sans).
colour: Notebook white with ruled blue lines and red margin, sticky-note yellow, pink and blue.
imagery: Polaroid-framed placeholders (white border, caption below), doodle SVGs.
details: Ruled-line backgrounds via repeating gradients, tape, circled words, arrows, checkmarks.

name: Architectural blueprint
idea: Drawn plans and elevations: precise lines, annotations, construction logic.
composition: Grid-paper backgrounds; diagrams as heroes; annotated callouts with leader lines; sections labelled like drawing sheets.
type: Technical sans and mono (IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono), small tracked labels.
colour: Blueprint blue with white lines, or white with cyan/graphite lines.
imagery: Line drawings in SVG; images framed by dimension lines.
details: Dimension arrows, sheet numbers, title blocks, crosshair markers, dashed lines.

name: Athletic energy
idea: Speed and power: slanted type, motion, competition.
composition: Diagonal cuts between sections; huge italic headlines; stats as hero numbers; dynamic off-axis layouts.
type: Heavy condensed italic (Barlow Condensed, Saira Condensed, Anton, Big Shoulders Display), all caps.
colour: Team colours: black, white and one or two high-energy colours (volt, red, cobalt).
imagery: Action placeholders with skewed frames; speed-line SVGs.
details: Skewed containers (skew-x), numbered jerseys, stripes, timers and stats.

name: Soft playful
idea: Friendly and approachable: round, bouncy and kind.
composition: Rounded blobs and pills; characters or mascots implied with simple SVG; stacked friendly cards; big clear buttons.
type: Rounded sans (Fredoka, Baloo 2, Nunito, Quicksand) at generous sizes.
colour: Candy pastels with one darker anchor colour for text.
imagery: Simple SVG illustrations (faces, stars, clouds) rather than photos.
details: Very large radius, soft coloured shadows, wavy dividers, emoji-free icon shapes.

name: Product-led interface
idea: Show the product working: the interface itself is the hero and the proof.
composition: Large realistic UI mockups (built from divs) in hero and features; annotated callouts; before/after comparisons; metrics strips.
type: Clean UI sans (Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, Figtree) with tabular numbers.
colour: Light neutral UI greys with the brand colour for active elements and charts.
imagery: Mock dashboards, phones and cards with believable data; small charts drawn with SVG.
details: Realistic UI chrome (tabs, toggles, avatars), subtle shadows, medium radius.

name: Monochrome gallery
idea: A gallery or portfolio: the work fills the walls, the interface disappears.
composition: Masonry or strict image grids; minimal text; captions as small labels; generous gutters; case studies as image sequences.
type: Neutral sans (Hanken Grotesk, Work Sans) very small, or a single elegant serif for titles.
colour: Pure white or gallery grey, black text; colour comes only from the work.
imagery: Many image placeholders of varied proportions with exhibition-style captions.
details: Index numbers, small arrows, hover-free calm, no radius, no shadows.

name: Hand-drawn sketch
idea: Drawn with a pen: wobbly lines, doodled icons, an illustrator's notebook.
composition: Loose layouts framed by sketchy boxes; arrows connecting ideas; illustrations beside text.
type: Hand lettering (Gochi Hand, Patrick Hand, Kalam) for headings and a simple sans for body.
colour: Paper white with ink black and one or two marker colours.
imagery: Inline SVG doodles with irregular strokes (stroke-linecap round, hand-like paths).
details: Sketchy borders (slightly irregular radius like rounded-[255px_15px_225px_15px/15px_225px_15px_255px]), scribbled underlines, hand-drawn arrows.

name: Civic and trustworthy
idea: Clear, accessible and serious: institutions, finance, health — trust through plainness.
composition: Clear hierarchy; left-aligned content; task-led sections; plain lists; prominent help and contact.
type: Highly legible sans (Source Sans 3, Public Sans, IBM Plex Sans) with a sober serif option (Source Serif 4).
colour: Deep blue or green, white, light grey panels; strong accessible contrast.
imagery: Modest photos of real people and places; simple icons.
details: Clear focus states, underlined links, simple cards with borders, small radius.

name: Afrofuturist
idea: Bold, celebratory futures: cosmic scale, metallic richness and pattern woven with technology.
composition: Monumental centred heroes; circular and radial compositions; layered pattern and light; sections as chapters of a story.
type: Wide or geometric display (Unbounded, Syne, Michroma) with a strong humanist sans (Outfit, Lexend).
colour: Deep purples, midnight blues and blacks with gold, copper and electric accents.
imagery: Radial gradient suns and planets, geometric pattern overlays, portrait placeholders in circular frames.
details: Concentric rings, metallic gradient text, star fields made with radial gradients.
